propositions: Merged work cites five analysis artifacts under docs/experiments/ that do not exist on origin/main, breaking the provenance trail for code-review calibration and write-parity oracle design.
The criteria_routing.json file contains three _comment fields citing docs/experiments/calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py, a file that has never been committed to the repository.

Five static documentation and analysis artifacts existed only as untracked working-tree state in one checkout, preventing inspection of the empirical basis for design decisions recorded in closed tickets.

Five pre-written artifacts were committed verbatim to docs/experiments/ (calibrate_code_review_thresholds.py, code-review-threshold-calibration.md, escaped_bug_analysis.py, escaped-bug-review-gap-analysis.md, write_parity_oracle_prototype.py) matching deliverables described in cranial-goodly-seahog and restoring-shallow-blobfish.
The landing touched only docs/experiments/ (835 insertions, no modifications to files outside that directory) and had no runtime or CI impact.
Gerrit change 1904 merged with LLM-Review +1 and Verified +1, making all five artifacts and their citations resolvable from main.
